section_1.title: Money you don't pay back.
section_1.description: On top of your loans — for childcare, learning costs, dependants and disability. Each is claimed on your SFE application, not automatic.

section_2.title: Additional help available
section_2.description: These extra grants are added directly onto your main SFE application profile.

cards.title: Parents' Learning Allowance
cards.description: Up to £2,024 per year to help with course materials, books and travel if you have dependants.

cards.title: Adult Dependants' Grant
cards.description: Up to £3,545 per year if you have an adult who depends on you financially.

cards.title: Disabled Students' Allowance (DSA)
cards.description: Support for computer software, specialized equipment and non-medical helpers.

faqs.q: How do I claim these grants?
faqs.a: You apply for them online through SFE at the same time as you apply for your main tuition and maintenance loans.

faqs.q: Are they based on household income?
faqs.a: Yes, most dependants' grants are assessed based on your partner's or household income.
